alex.name: Alex Neale
alex.source: Extract from a LinkedIn recommendation, August 2026
text: What immediately stood out was that Martyn wasn't simply a recruiter trying to fill a vacancy. He genuinely understands the flooring industry and what makes someone successful within it. He understood exactly what I needed as a small independent flooring business and built the recruitment process around finding the right long-term fit.

Martyn managed the entire process from start to finish. He sourced and filtered candidates, carried out the first-stage interviews and only introduced people to me when he believed they were a good fit. That alone saved me a huge amount of time and meant every interview was worthwhile.

What really set Martyn apart, though, was that his involvement didn't stop once the role had been filled. He spent time in the business with our new team member, helping build solid foundations from day one.

alexshort.name: Alex Neale
text: What immediately stood out was that Martyn wasn't simply a recruiter trying to fill a vacancy. He genuinely understands the flooring industry and what makes someone successful within it.
The cost of getting it wrong is far greater than the cost of bringing in the right expert.

alexafter.name: Alex Neale
alexafter.source: Extract from a LinkedIn recommendation, August 2026
text: Recruitment isn't just about filling a vacancy. It's about creating the best possible partnership between the business and the individual. Martyn understands how to identify the right people and, just as importantly, how to give both employer and employee the greatest chance of building a successful, long-term working relationship.
If you're recruiting within the flooring industry, I wouldn't hesitate to recommend him.

malcolm.name: Malcolm Gordon
text: Martyn quickly established himself as a trusted advisor, offering clear, strategic insights and practical recommendations. His ability to analyse complex market dynamics and translate them into actionable strategies has been particularly impressive.
I would not hesitate to recommend Martyn to any organisation seeking a knowledgeable and results-driven consultant within the flooring sector.

malcolmstores.name: Malcolm Gordon
text: MC Growth Consultancy has been instrumental in helping us improve our systems and efficiency. Their expert guidance has supported our new store openings and been crucial in sourcing franchise partners, allowing us to scale in a challenging market.

ryan.name: Ryan Fisher
ryan.source: Extract from a LinkedIn recommendation, March 2026
text: Martyn quickly identified areas for improvement especially for efficiency. Martyn was direct with his recommendations, impressively communicating solutions to problems we had. Martyn produced a new SOP for our customer journey and went through this with me and my staff.
After the week was over Martyn produced a 60 page report on my business. A plan to take my business forward, to increase sales, to improve efficiency and to be successful.

andy.name: Andy Law
andy.source: Extract from a LinkedIn recommendation, March 2026
text: His understanding of the flooring industry, combined with a practical, no-nonsense approach, has allowed us to implement systems and procedures that genuinely make a difference. From improving our internal processes to helping us think more strategically about growth, Martyn has played an important role in moving the business forward.
He is approachable, knowledgeable and always focused on finding solutions that work in the real world.

jack.name: Jack Findlay
text: We've had the pleasure of working with Martyn for the last 6 months and in such a short period of time he's made an immense impact on our business. Highly knowledgeable and experienced within his field. Couldn't recommend him enough to others.

jackinstallers.name: Jack Findlay
text: Martyn helped us plan the scaling of our business by implementing effective tools and methods to source new customers. His expertise in sourcing commercial flooring installers at scale has been particularly valuable to our growth strategy.

andrew.name: Andrew Thurgood
text: Having worked with Martyn recently, he is impressive and totally focused. You tell him what you want and he delivers with a professional smile. Basically you get exactly what it says on the tin. Big plus, really nice bloke!

toni.name: Toni Wood
toni.role: Chief Customer Officer, Helping Hands Homecare
text: Martyn is a highly driven and commercial leader. He quickly understands what it takes to drive value creation and puts structure and process in place to ensure he and his teams deliver. He has the ability to 'think' and 'do', meaning he can truly roll up his sleeves when needed; coaching his colleagues and team to deliver.

jody.name: Jody Warren
text: Martyn played a key role in navigating a large-scale structural change within a £600m business, showing both resilience and leadership in a complex environment. What sets him apart is his versatility - he has the rare ability to work seamlessly across both retail and distribution channels.

robert.name: Robert Marsh
text: Martyn possesses a very effective skillset that allows him to quickly assimilate information from various data points, and devise an effective plan to generate and sustain profitable sales.
He achieves results not through control but through consensus, which is vital for a sustainable sales operating model.

patrick.name: Patrick Stirling-Howe
text: Martyn is a dedicated and hardworking individual whose commitment to excellence was apparent in every project he undertook. His communication skills are exceptional, which, coupled with his collaborative working style, significantly contributed to our team's cohesion and overall success.

stephanie.name: Stephanie Drabble
text: He is highly commercial yet pragmatic. Martyn knows how to get the best out of people through honesty, empathy, integrity and through having a great sense of humour. Martyn is the kind of leader everyone wants to work for and work with.

stevej.name: Steve Johnson
stevej.role: Head of Central Operations, Tapi Carpets
text: He is a deadline driven professional, independent and customer focused strategist. He delivers innovative solutions and always strives for perfection whilst delivering a first class end product and service.

sam.name: Sam Ajanlekoko
text: I had the pleasure of working with Martyn for several months at Carpetright where we successfully delivered a new resource scheduling service platform into Dynamics ERP which was rolled out nationwide. Martyn has excellent management skills, he's open minded with strong knowledge of his services, his team on the ground and end customers.

paul.name: Paul Ruler
text: He consistently provides valid and vital input, along with solutions in areas where the detail really does matter.

alfie.name: Alfie Joey
alfie.source: Saw Martyn speak at the Momentum conference
text: His astute thoughts on leadership were inspiring and full of value, specific to that audience in the room. If you are in need of a speaker or coach in this area he would be fantastic for groups and individuals alike.
